consensus_blend.fade_trigger: invert the 10% public weight if public_bet_pct > 70% on one side

real_time_triggers.injury_update: re-run projection 90 mins pre-game using official inactive list
real_time_triggers.weather_override: wind > 15mph = passing props -15%; rain = under on total points

confidence_logic.Medium: variance 10-20% OR one external factor disagrees

rules.umpire_zone: expanded strike zone (umpire top-10 in K%) = +15% Ks for pitcher
rules.platoon_splits: heavy weight on LHB vs RHP (+12%) and RHB vs LHP (+8%)
rules.bullpen_usage: if starter pitch count > 100 last outing, reduce projection -10% (fatigue)

rules.small_sample_regression: shrink 40% toward league mean for ALL players (season < 40 games)
rules.home_away: +2% at home, -2% on road (smaller venue effect)
rules.international_break: reduce projection -10% if player just returned from FIBA duties

rules.back_to_back: -5% projection if team played previous day
rules.rest_advantage: +5% if opponent played previous day and team did not
rules.foul_trouble: reduce projection -20% if player has >3 fouls in 1st half (in-game only)

rules.possession_adjustment: project drives using league-average (10-12 per team), adjust by pace
rules.home_field: +5% for offense if home, -5% for away
rules.injury_boost: if WR1 out, WR2 gets +15% target share; if RB1 out, RB2 gets +20% rush share

rules.backups: use 3-year preseason mean, regress 30% toward league mean

rules.back_to_back_goalie: if goalie started previous night, -15% Saves projection
rules.playoff_intensity: if playoff game, reduce scoring -10% (tighter defense)
